name: How much does Website Entity Optimization typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does Website Entity Optimization typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Website Entity Optimization varies widely depending on the size and complexity of your website, the volume of content, and the specific goals of the optimization project. It can range from a few thousand dollars for smaller, more focused projects to tens of thousands for comprehensive, enterprise-level implementations. Factors influencing cost include the depth of semantic analysis required, the amount of schema markup implementation, ongoing monitoring, and content restructuring efforts. A detailed audit is usually necessary to provide an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on website size, content volume, and project scope, ranging from thousands to tens of thousands of dollars. A detailed audit is needed for an accurate estimate.
